general.tmdbDesc: Used to fetch movie and TV metadata, posters, ratings, and cast info from The Movie Database.

tmdbLanguage.title: Metadata Language
tmdbLanguage.description: Language used when fetching titles, descriptions, and other metadata from TMDB. Changing this clears the metadata cache so updated content loads immediately.

content.ageDescription: Set a maximum age rating. Content rated above this age will still be visible but you won't be able to play it. Set to No restriction to disable this feature entirely.

playback.unreachable: Could not reach instance. Check the URL or try another.
playback.invidiousDesc: Trailers are played via Invidious, a privacy-friendly YouTube frontend. Your configured instance is tried first; if it fails, the app automatically falls back through a list of known working instances. The default is {{defaultBase}}. The instance must have its API enabled (/api/v1/stats reachable).
playback.thresholdDesc: A movie or episode is automatically marked as <ok>Watched ✓</ok> when the remaining time drops to this value or below. Set between 1 and 300 seconds.
playback.autoplayDesc: Configure how the player behaves when an episode finishes.
playback.enableAutoplayDesc: Automatically play the next episode when the current one ends.
playback.countdownDesc: Number of seconds to display the countdown. Set to 0 to only show the buttons and not autoplay automatically.
playback.overlayDesc: Choose which side of the player the next episode thumbnail and details are shown.
playback.introDesc: Uses <hl>AniSkip</hl> to detect and skip opening/ending segments. Only active for animes and when using <hl>HiAnime</hl> as source.
playback.introAutoDesc: Automatically jumps past the intro/outro when reached.
playback.introManualDesc: Shows a "Skip Intro" button at the bottom of the player.

subtitles.title: Subtitle Downloads
subtitles.sourceInfo: <hl>Wyzie Subs</hl> is used by default and requires a free API key (no account needed). Optionally add a <link>SubDL API key</link> (free), to use SubDL as the primary source instead.
subtitles.wyzieKeyDesc: Required for Wyzie Subs. Get a free key by following the tutorial.
subtitles.subdlKeyDesc: Leave empty to use Wyzie Subs (default, requires Wyzie API key above). Add a SubDL key to switch to SubDL as the primary source.
subtitles.subdlPlaceholder: SubDL API key, leave empty to use Wyzie

downloads.folderDesc: Downloaded videos will be saved here. Make sure the folder exists and Streambert has write access to it.
downloads.noFolder: ⚠ No download folder set - videos cannot be downloaded until you set one.

notifications.title: Desktop Notifications
notifications.description: Control which events trigger a desktop notification.
notifications.downloadDesc: Shows a desktop notification when an item finishes downloading.
notifications.episodeLabel: Notify about new episodes on startup
notifications.episodeDesc: On startup, checks every TV series you have saved for newly released episodes and notifies you if any aired since the last check.

discord.title: Discord Rich Presence
discord.description: Shows what you're currently watching on your Discord profile (title + cover, or "Idling" when nothing is open). Off by default. Requires the Discord desktop client to be running.
discord.enableDesc: Connects to your local Discord client and updates your status automatically.
discord.coverDesc: Uses the movie/show poster as the large image. When off, only the Streambert icon is shown.
discord.timeDesc: Displays how long you've been on the current title's page.
discord.buttonDesc: Adds a button linking to the Streambert GitHub repository.

storage.installDesc: Opens the folder where Streambert is installed.
storage.clearCacheDesc: Removes temporary browser cache, shader cache, and service worker data from all internal sessions (main, video player, trailer). Does not affect your personal data or settings.
storage.progressDesc: Resets all watch history, continue-watching progress, and watched / completed markings for movies and series. Also clears internal video player session data.
storage.progressConfirmDesc: This will permanently delete all watch history, continue-watching progress, and watched/completed markings for all movies and series.
storage.deleteDesc: Permanently deletes all video files that were downloaded through Streambert and removes them from the download list. Only files downloaded through the app will be deleted, nothing else in your folder is touched.
storage.deleteConfirmDesc: This will permanently delete all video files downloaded through Streambert and remove them from the download list.
storage.resetDesc: Completely resets Streambert to factory defaults, clears all settings, API Token, saved library, watch history/progress, and all cached data. Your downloaded video files will not be touched.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.accentApplied: {{colour}}, applied to buttons, highlights, and indicators.
appearance.accentInPlayer: Apply accent colour to streaming player
appearance.accentInPlayerDesc: Passes the selected accent colour to the player source (Videasy, Vidking). VidSrc does not support colour theming.
appearance.compactDesc: Shows more titles per row by reducing card size.
appearance.reduceAnimDesc: Disables transitions and hover effects throughout the app.
appearance.controllerDesc: Navigate menus with a D-pad/stick and use A/B to select and go back. In the player: A play/pause, D-pad seek/volume, LB/RB skip ±15s, Y fullscreen, B exit.

library.title: Library & Privacy
library.sortOrderDesc: How titles in your watchlist are sorted. "Custom order" keeps your drag-and-drop arrangement.
library.recordHistoryDesc: When off, nothing you watch will be added to history or "Continue Watching".
library.historyDisabled: ⚠ Watch history is disabled. Progress tracking and "Continue Watching" will not work.

startPage.title: Start Page
startPage.description: Choose which page opens when you launch Streambert.

setup.intro:
Enter your free TMDB Read Access Token to get started.
Go to themoviedb.org → Settings → API and copy the API Read Access Token (the long JWT, not the shorter API Key below).
Step-by-step guide on how to get that Token
setup.tokenPlaceholder: Paste your TMDB Read Access Token (eyJ...)...

invalidToken.title: Invalid token
invalidToken.body: TMDB rejected the token (401 Unauthorized). Make sure you copied the long JWT Read Access Token, not the shorter API Key.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.body: TMDB returned 403 Forbidden. Your account may be suspended or the token may have been revoked.

timeout.body: TMDB took too long to respond. Check your internet connection and try again.

unreachable.title: Cannot reach TMDB
unreachable.body: No connection to api.themoviedb.org. Check your internet connection.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
